description: This Java class `BooleanInputsModel` manages a set of boolean input states, including titles and text labels for true/false states, and provides methods to retrieve and set these values.

classes.name: BooleanInputsModel
classes.description: Model class representing boolean input states with associated labels and titles.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns a formatted title string for a given input channel, based on an internal mapping.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the boolean value for a specific input channel.

methods.name: getValueLabelText
methods.description: Returns the label text associated with a boolean value for a specific input channel.
